author: Zouluk
quote: The game offers several fun courses, the gameplay is really good and provides multiple alternatives for the cars. The cutscenes between the characters are cool and sometimes interesting. The game is easy to pick up and learn. Maybe the only downside is that tickets take a long time to farm, but other than that, everything else is good.
